title: Low-Temperature Large Deviations for the Two-Dimensional Wick-Ordered Cubic Wave Equation
summary: We prove a trajectory large deviation principle, in the low-temperature limit, for the two-dimensional Wick-ordered defocusing cubic nonlinear wave equation, with initial data drawn from the invariant Gibbs measure. We further show that asymptotically vanishing high-frequency perturbations of the Gibbs initial data, with the same static rate function, generate a continuum of distinct mass-shifted trajectory rate functions.
